name: xbert-payroll-close
description: Pre-run sanity checks and post-run reconciliation for every pay cycle, including STP Phase 2 hygiene and bank-out reconciliation.

x-xbert.tagline: Pre-run sanity checks and post-run reconciliation across every pay cycle.
prerequisites: Client with active payroll in the connected ledger (Xero / MYOB / QuickBooks Online)
At least one prior pay run for variance comparison
x-xbert.longDescription:
Payroll is the highest-stakes weekly task in a bookkeeping practice. New hires get missed, terminations get processed late, leave applications sit unapproved, super percentages drift after a salary change, and STP Phase 2 codes silently break compliance. The errors are mostly small individually but compound across pay cycles and become very expensive when they finally surface — usually via the employee, never via the bookkeeper.

XBert Payroll Close runs as both a pre-run sanity check (before you post the pay) and a post-run reconciliation (after the pay is posted but before the bank file goes out). It checks every employee for the things that go wrong week after week — leave hits, super rates, STP P2 hygiene, new starters who weren't added in time, terminations that weren't processed — then reconciles the posted pay run against the prior pay's variance bands and the bank-out total against the sum of net pays. The bookkeeper still owns the pay run; the plugin owns the checking.

useCases.title: Pre-run sanity check
useCases.description: Before you process the weekly pay, get a list of every employee who needs attention: new starters not yet set up, leave applications unapproved, super rate changes, address changes affecting STP.

useCases.title: Post-run variance check
useCases.description: After posting the pay run, compare totals against the prior pay — net pay, super, PAYG. Anything outside the variance band gets surfaced before the bank file goes out.

useCases.title: STP Phase 2 hygiene
useCases.description: Catch missing income type, country code, tax treatment, or category mappings that would cause a P2 submission to reject or misreport.

useCases.title: Bank-out reconciliation
useCases.description: Confirm the ABA / bank file total equals the sum of employee net pays before you upload — the simplest check that catches the most expensive mistakes.

benefits.title: Catch errors before the bank file uploads
benefits.description: Net-pay variance, super-rate drift, missing STP fields, and bank-out mismatches all surface in the same pre-flight check — before money moves and before submissions go to the ATO.

benefits.title: Cuts the weekly pay-run check from 30 mins to 5
benefits.description: Replace the spreadsheet-and-checklist routine with one chat command. Pre-run sanity and post-run reconciliation in a single workflow.

benefits.title: STP Phase 2 compliance on autopilot
benefits.description: Every pay run gets checked for the P2 fields the ATO has been making mandatory since 2022 — income type, country code, tax treatment, category mapping.

workflow: Confirm the client, pay period, and whether this is a pre-run or post-run check
Plugin pulls pay-run, payslip, employee, leave, and settings data via the XBert MCP
Pre-run sanity report (or post-run variance + reconciliation report) is presented in chat with named employees and amounts
You action each flagged item in the ledger; the plugin never posts the pay run for you
